body:
## Summary

Part of a series of PRs refactoring `test_torch.py` for out-of-tree backends.

This one splits the remaining mixed CPU/CUDA tests into their corresponding test classes and loosens the CUDA-only gates on tests that do not actually need CUDA.

## Changes

Split the remaining mixed CPU/CUDA tests into the appropriate test classes:

- `test_copy_transpose_tiled_small`
- `test_split_with_sizes_copy_out`
- `test_bmm_matmul_mixed_dtype_error`
- `test_no_cuda_monkeypatch`
- `test_bf16_supported_on_cpu`

Made several CUDA-only tests device-generic:

- `test_copy_transpose_tiled*`
- `test_cdist_backward_large_index`
- `test_ternary_op_mem_overlap`
- `test_where_scalar_handcrafted_values`

## Test Plan

Verified on CUDA 

```bash
pytest test/test_torch.py -vvv -k "test_copy_transpose_tiled or test_cdist_backward_large_index or test_ternary_op_mem_overlap or test_where_scalar_handcrafted_values or test_split_with_sizes_copy_out or test_bmm_matmul_mixed_dtype_error or test_bf16_supported_on_cpu or test_no_cuda_monkeypatch"

# 100 passed, 99 skipped, 1939 deselected in 17.46s

PYTORCH_TEST_WITH_INDUCTOR=1 pytest test/test_torch.py -vvv -k "test_copy_transpose_tiled or test_cdist_backward_large_index or test_ternary_op_mem_overlap or test_where_scalar_handcrafted_values or test_split_with_sizes_copy_out or test_bmm_matmul_mixed_dtype_error or test_bf16_supported_on_cpu or test_no_cuda_monkeypatch"

# 98 passed, 101 skipped, 1939 deselected in 202.01s (0:03:22)
```
title: [Test] Improve test reuse in test_torch.py for out-of-tree backends [8/N]
